29-559.summary: Raichur district confronts alarming child malnutrition levels, with 36.8% of children under five stunted, 31.3% underweight and 21.6% wasted. Maternal anaemia affects about 57% of women aged 15-49, with pregnant women reaching 73% anaemia rates—the state's highest. Poverty forces families like Kavitha's to subsist on inadequate rations, where rice from public distribution lasts less than a week. Despite government interventions including nutrition rehabilitation centres and special programmes, 89,000 children remain malnourished, underweight or stunted. The crisis stems from abject poverty, with many children receiving only one meal daily at anganwadi centres, while lacking adequate nutrition at home.
